calls.video_title: A Dip Like This Only Comes Once a Decade
calls.price_at_call: 3-yr forecast ~$3,000 per $1,000; medium confidence (first tracked BWB call)
calls.thesis: CONDITIONAL_BUY, first tracked — hard-drive "warehouse" layer; pricing power in its purest form (about 22% more storage shipped, about 28% more per terabyte). CONDITIONAL_BUY — buy in pieces (dollar-cost average on the way down), not all at once; only while the memory shortage holds.
calls.base_case: No new hard-drive factories announced; supply grows only ~25%/yr by packing more per drive while demand grows faster; Morgan Stanley sees warehouses short every year through 2028.
calls.bull_case: Shortage persists and per-terabyte pricing holds.
calls.bear_case: Gains rest on higher per-terabyte prices, which can fall.
